item.title: Returning from vacation? The government can search your phone without a warrant
item.description:
📝 According to the seven-page complaint, Thomas Kennedy said that a Customs and Border Protection agent at Miami International Airport physically searched his bags, questioned him about his books and magazines, and then demanded that he hand over his phone. ” The agent took the phone away and only returned after approximately 45 minutes, during which Kennedy believes that data on the phone was copied. ” CBP says that such searches of electronic devices are very rare.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/09/immigration-advocate-sues-border-agents-for-demanding-his-cell-phone/
